scope: Android Compose product UI against the production database and its real RLS/RPC behavior through an explicitly authorized loopback Auth/PostgREST facade

observations.retry: The first block was forced to fail before transport; the UI exposed its optimistic unblock state, restored the original block action with an error, and the same visible Retry control converged to a production block edge.
observations.navigation: The peer avatar opened the shared public profile and the test returned to the same Chat after retry convergence.

limits: Hosted Supabase Auth returned HTTP 402, so authentication and REST transport were supplied by the opt-in emulator-loopback facade while retaining the production database, RLS and RPC behavior.
The facade did not implement hosted Realtime and this focal report does not certify the hosted Auth/API gateway.

provenance.dependencyOnlyAttempt: The first invocation stopped before fixture creation because the new worktree did not yet link the repository's installed Node dependencies.
